Definition (known at close of t): SPY log return on days t, t−1, …, t−4
Financial rationale: Short-horizon autocorrelation / reversal of index returns
Time-series momentum: past trends tend to persist
Source: Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen (2012); Jegadeesh and Titman (1993)

Financial rationale: Trend-following: price relative to its moving average had predictive content for the index
Trend acceleration: momentum of the trend itself
Volatility clusters; high volatility predicts weaker risk-adjusted returns
Intraday range is an efficient volatility estimator

Definition (known at close of t): ln(V_t / 20-day mean V); ln(5-day / 60-day mean V)
Financial rationale: Volume conditions the sign of return autocorrelation; confirms trend strength

Definition (known at close of t): 5-day sector log return minus SPY 5-day log return
Financial rationale: Industry returns lead the aggregate market

Definition (known at close of t): Share of the 9 sectors above their own 50-day SMA
Financial rationale: Breadth of participation in the market trend

Definition (known at close of t): ln VIX_{t−1}; 5-day change in ln VIX (lagged one day)
Financial rationale: Implied volatility as a gauge of fear and expected risk
Variance risk premium predicts index returns
Term spread tracks the business cycle and expected returns; predicts recessions
Source: Campbell (1987); Fama and French (1989); Estrella and Mishkin (1998)

Definition (known at close of t): 3-month yield; 20-day change in 10-year yield (lagged one day)
Financial rationale: Short rate and rate shocks predict equity returns
